protocol.py: 3 biology problems (2 errors, 1 note).

1. ERROR SOURCE-TOO-SHALLOW: The pipette draws air from well A1 in slot 5: the liquid is
below the tip
   line 58:  p20.aspirate(9, water_reservoir["A1"])
   At line 58 the p20_single_gen2 draws 9 ul from water (well A1 in slot 5) with its tip 1
   mm above the bottom of the well. By then the well holds 193 ul, which in this NEST 12
   Well Reservoir 15 mL reaches only 0.90 mm up: the tip is above the liquid and draws air
   (this line did it 19 times, after 5 times in the liquid; 171 ul of air in all). The
   simulator does not notice: it does not follow the liquid. The 19 wells filled from these
   draws got air instead of liquid.
   Affected: well A1 in slot 5.
   Also reached 19 other wells: wells A6, A7, A8, A9, A10, A11, A12, B1 and 11 more in slot
   3.
   Fix: Keep the liquid above the tip. This well needs about 258 ul in it for the surface to
   reach 1 mm. Load that much more than the run draws; or draw from a smaller vessel (a tube
   lifts the liquid); or aspirate lower with `well.bottom(0.5)`.
   Source: Opentrons: liquid control (aspirates 1 mm above the bottom of the well by
   default)
           https://docs.opentrons.com/v2/basic_commands/liquids.html
   Source: Artel: automated liquid handlers as sources of error
           https://www.bioprocessintl.com/assays/automated-liquid-handlers-as-sources-of-error
   Source: Gilson guide to pipetting (immersion depth 2 to 3 mm for 1 to 100 ul)
           https://solutions.pipette.com/wp-content/uploads/Gilson-Guide-to-Pipetting.pdf
   Source: labautomation.io 7592: negative controls positive after aspirating air
           https://labautomation.io/t/aspiration-dispense-liquid-class-incompatibity/7592
   Source: Integra: 260 ul dead volume in a standard reservoir
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applications/minimizing-dead-volume-during-qpcr-set-divided-reservoir-assist-plus-pipetting-robot
   [b8c802568861]

2. ERROR SOURCE-TOO-SHALLOW: The pipette draws air from well A2 in slot 4: the liquid is
below the tip
   line 87:  p20.aspirate(1, cold_block["A2"])
   At line 87 the p20_single_gen2 draws 1 ul from ligase (well A2 in slot 4) with its tip 1
   mm above the bottom of the well. By then the well holds 3 ul, which in this Opentrons 24
   Well Aluminum Block with NEST 1.5 mL Snapcap reaches only 0.82 mm up: the tip is above
   the liquid and draws air (this line did it once, after 23 times in the liquid; 1 ul of
   air in all). The simulator does not notice: it does not follow the liquid. The 1 well
   filled from these draws got air instead of liquid.
   Affected: well A2 in slot 4.
   Also reached 1 other well: well B12 in slot 3.
   Fix: Keep the liquid above the tip. This well needs about 6 ul in it for the surface to
   reach 1 mm. Load that much more than the run draws; or draw from a smaller vessel (a tube
   lifts the liquid); or aspirate lower with `well.bottom(0.5)`.

findings.title: The pipette draws air from well A1 in slot 5: the liquid is below the tip
findings.explanation: At line 58 the p20_single_gen2 draws 9 ul from water (well A1 in slot 5) with its tip 1 mm above the bottom of the well. By then the well holds 193 ul, which in this NEST 12 Well Reservoir 15 mL reaches only 0.90 mm up: the tip is above the liquid and draws air (this line did it 19 times, after 5 times in the liquid; 171 ul of air in all). The simulator does not notice: it does not follow the liquid. The 19 wells filled from these draws got air instead of liquid.
findings.fix: Keep the liquid above the tip. This well needs about 258 ul in it for the surface to reach 1 mm. Load that much more than the run draws; or draw from a smaller vessel (a tube lifts the liquid); or aspirate lower with `well.bottom(0.5)`.

findings.title: The pipette draws air from well A2 in slot 4: the liquid is below the tip
findings.explanation: At line 87 the p20_single_gen2 draws 1 ul from ligase (well A2 in slot 4) with its tip 1 mm above the bottom of the well. By then the well holds 3 ul, which in this Opentrons 24 Well Aluminum Block with NEST 1.5 mL Snapcap reaches only 0.82 mm up: the tip is above the liquid and draws air (this line did it once, after 23 times in the liquid; 1 ul of air in all). The simulator does not notice: it does not follow the liquid. The 1 well filled from these draws got air instead of liquid.
findings.fix: Keep the liquid above the tip. This well needs about 6 ul in it for the surface to reach 1 mm. Load that much more than the run draws; or draw from a smaller vessel (a tube lifts the liquid); or aspirate lower with `well.bottom(0.5)`.

findings.title: 23 wells never mixed after ligase went in (5 to 9% of the well)
findings.explanation: At line 88 the robot added ligase to wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 15 more in slot 3, which already held water, buffer, insert 1, vector and 22 more (this line did it 23 times). The addition was 5 to 9% of the well, nothing mixed the well afterwards, and the run ended with them that way. Two liquids layered in a small well do not mix on their own, so what the well holds is not at the concentration you calculated. If the plate is vortexed and spun down before it is used, nothing is wrong; if it goes straight to the instrument, the wells are not what the protocol says they are.
findings.fix: Mix wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 15 more in slot 3 after line 88: `mix_after=(5, 9 to 16)` on the transfer, or `pipette.mix(5, 9 to 16, well)`, with the volume about 80% of what the well holds.
